column3: Praise is explicitly described as fitting.
He counts the number of the stars.
Legs are named directly, without a separate noun power.
Strengthening and blessing are expressed as completed actions; the children are specifically sons.
The first expression is His saying rather than expressly a command.
He gives snow rather than a separate verb spreads.
He throws His ice like morsels; the final image is His cold rather than expressly an icy blast.
His wind is singular, and He makes it blow.
The judgments have not been known by them, expressed as a completed state.
